description:
FOR: whichever seat works stoagen-com. Filed by Polybius the Grand (user-tier chief of staff) 2026-08-21 at PRINCIPAL direction. This is the first ticket in this store.

WHAT THIS STORE IS. Beadwork (bw) for denson/stoagen-com, prefix sg, on the orphan branch named beadwork. It holds this project's own tickets. Run bw prime from the repo root at the start of every session. Push tickets with: git push origin beadwork. Pushing main does not push tickets.

WHERE THE KIT LIVES. The full list of what you need to build Stoas of agents is at user-tier, not here:

  repo:   C:\Users\denso\claude_projects\user-beadwork  (github.com/denson/user-beadwork, branch beadwork)
  ticket: u--0dx  "[STOAGEN] Kit: everything needed to build Stoas of agents"
  read:   cd C:\Users\denso\claude_projects\user-beadwork && bw show u--0dx

u--0dx carries nine sections: source of truth (the-stoa repo and spec), the substrate (MAJOR and CAPTAIN role files, operating-disciplines, modules, templates, skills), installing into a workspace (install.sh, bootstrap-bw.sh, drift tools, plugin packaging), the bw store, launching seats (team-launcher, gauntlet-setup, handoffs), authoring new seats, the non-optional disciplines (authorship, credentials, fix-now, web-first, human-attention map), worked examples, and known gaps at filing time.

VISIBILITY RULE. User-tier reads and writes down into this store; this store never writes up into user-beadwork. If you need the Grand, post a comment on a ticket HERE tagged [for: Polybius the Grand] and it gets picked up on the next downward poll. Do not create or comment on u-- tickets from this seat.

WHAT TO DO, IN ORDER.
1. Read u--0dx end to end. Then read the stoagen-com repo root README.md and site-src/CLAUDE.md; the site rules there (Markdown-first, superset mirrors, git-derived dates, one script per page, allow-all robots with Content-Signal, build + validate every time, only main deploys) hold for everything you ship.
2. Make sure the-stoa is present locally at C:\Users\denso\claude_projects\the-stoa (it was on 2026-08-21, last commit 9e612d2a 2026-07-17). If it is missing: gh repo clone denson/the-stoa into claude_projects.
3. Decide with PRINCIPAL whether this workspace gets the substrate installed (the-stoa substrate/install.sh --project-dir . plus registration in substrate/consumer-workspaces.txt) or stays a single-seat site workspace. Installing gives you POLYBIUS / PLINY / the CAPTAIN roster here; not installing keeps the repo lean. Surface the choice, do not pick it silently.
4. File one child ticket here under this one for each thing the site needs. PRINCIPAL said the site needs a bunch of things; the list has not been captured yet. Capture it as tickets, one item each, with a concrete next action per ticket, before building any of them.
5. Two open PRINCIPAL calls recorded at u--0dx section 9, to be settled here: this repo has no LICENSE file (public repo, all rights reserved by default), and the sibling demo denson/pueblo-srda-questions has no bw store and no LICENSE either.
6. Comment on u--0dx ONLY via the [for: Polybius the Grand] tag on a ticket here (rule above) with anything in the kit that turned out wrong or missing.

AUTHORSHIP. Every author, owner, creator, by or copyright field on anything built here says Denson Smith. README already does. A different name anywhere is a stop and ask, never a silent edit.

NEXT ACTION. Step 1, then step 4. Close this ticket when the child tickets exist and step 3 has a recorded decision.
title: [START HERE] Building Stoas of agents for stoagen: the kit is at user-tier u--0dx; read it, then file one ticket per thing the site needs
